zh.name: 纺粘+熔喷+纺粘无纺布
zh.tagline: 主要用于防护层、隔离层及医用耗材
zh.description: 透气适中，柔软，可做三抗处理，主要用于制作普通手术衣、隔离衣、垫单、普通防护服
features: 力学性能好：纺粘长丝赋予布较高抗拉、抗撕裂强度，耐磨、不易掉屑，比纯熔喷布结实很多。
高阻隔过滤：中间熔喷超细纤维，可阻挡细菌、粉尘、飞沫、血液、体液；可做到高细菌过滤效率。
透气拒水：液体难以穿透，但水汽可以透过，防护同时不闷。
柔软亲肤，无毒无味，适合直接接触皮肤，一次性使用。
可功能改性：可做三抗（抗酒精、抗血浆、抗水）、抗静电、亲水、抗菌、抗紫外线等处理。
一次性为主，成本适中，热轧粘合，无化学胶水。

en.name: SMS  Nonwoven Fabric
en.tagline: Primarily used for protective layers, isolation layers, and medical consumables
en.description: It is moderately breathable and soft, and can undergo three-resistance treatment. It is mainly used for making ordinary surgical gowns, isolation gowns, pads, and ordinary protective clothing.
features: Good mechanical properties: Spunbond filaments impart high tensile and tear resistance to the fabric, making it wear-resistant and less prone to shedding, and much stronger than pure meltblown fabric.
High-barrier filtration: The intermediate melt-blown ultrafine fibers can block bacteria, dust, droplets, blood, and body fluids; achieving high bacterial filtration efficiency.
Breathable and water-repellent: Liquid is difficult to penetrate, but water vapor can pass through, providing protection without being stifling.
Soft and skin-friendly, non-toxic and odorless, suitable for direct contact with skin, single-use only.

Functional modification: It can be treated with various functionalities such as alcohol resistance, plasma resistance, water resistance, antistatic properties, hydrophilicity, antibacterial properties, and UV resistance.
Primarily disposable, with moderate cost, hot-rolled bonding, and no chemical glue.
